title: Awesome Device Afterlife
title_zh: Awesome Device Afterlife · 旧设备的新用途
tagline_zh: 让旧设备，再有一个好用途。
description: An illustrated collection of useful new jobs for hardware you already own: phones, e-readers, computers, consoles and retired connected devices.
description_zh: 从手头已有的手机、阅读器、电脑、游戏机和退役联网设备出发，寻找值得动手的新用途。每个项目都附条件、步骤和原始来源。

categories.name: Phones and tablets
categories.description: Cameras, displays, instruments and dedicated appliances made from spare mobile devices.
categories.description_zh: 把闲置移动设备变成摄像头、显示器、测量工具或专用终端。

categories.name: E-readers
categories.description: E-ink dashboards, desktop companions and expanded reading workflows.
categories.description_zh: 墨水屏看板、桌面助理，以及更丰富的阅读用途。

categories.name: Computers
categories.description: Give a retired computer one clear job: entertainment, storage, automation or offline knowledge.
categories.description_zh: 为退役电脑安排一个明确用途：影音、存储、自动化或离线知识服务。

categories.name: Routers
categories.description: Extend a network using supported hardware and a documented configuration.
categories.description_zh: 用仍受支持的硬件和明确配置，扩展现有网络。

categories.name: Consoles
categories.description: New roles for older consoles, with homebrew and legacy limits made explicit.
categories.description_zh: 旧游戏机的新用途，明确标注自制软件环境与旧版限制。

categories.name: Retired connected devices
categories.description: Keep useful hardware alive through replacement software, local services and new interfaces.
categories.description_zh: 借助替代软件、本地服务和新界面，让仍可用的硬件继续工作。
